quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on prioritizing winning over being the best
quotes.excerpt: I don't care about being the best. I care about being a winner.
quotes.quote: I don't care about being the best. I care about being a winner. We gotta do our job, man. If we do our job and we win games, then we'll see.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on embracing the Miami Heat culture
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it helped me a lot to kind of immerse myself to the culture.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Playing pickup, doing the conditioning tests together, I feel like it helped me a lot to kind of immerse myself to the culture. I feel like it's a culture that fits my personality.

text_blocks.speaker: Bam Adebayo
text_blocks.text: It's our players and staff, best condition.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Coach's advice to appreciate the moment
quotes.excerpt: Make sure you appreciate the moment. It goes by fast.
quotes.quote: I have so many funny stories from Coach now. He said, 'Hey, young fella, make sure you appreciate the moment. It goes by fast. You're gonna look up in ten years and it's going to go by, so appreciate the moment.' That was my first advice, and then you look 14 years later, he's my coach.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his commitment to community involvement
quotes.excerpt: Be able to immerse into the community and to the culture of whatever city I am.
quotes.quote: That's what I've done my whole career, be able to immerse into the community and to the culture of whatever city I am. When I was 18, I did the same thing in Milwaukee. To be able to go out there, I feel like it means a lot to the fans here in the city, and it's something I want to do more often.
